ctx.x: Uh-huh, and I also work with Chris Kelly, one of them old times, you know. On drums and them? No, on piano. Yeah. I put the drums down there, because I got hired more on piano, you know what I mean?
George Williams said he worked with Chris on drums. Yeah, he did.
